summary: "Super Best Friends" is the third episode of the fifth season of the animated series "South Park" and the series' 68th episode overall, first aired on Comedy Central on July 4, 2001. Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny join the cult of magician David Blaine, the Blaintologists, after seeing him perform in South Park. Stan discovers the cult is sinister, tries to persuade the others they have been brainwashed, and with Jesus calls on the Super Best Friends, a parody of the Super Friends, to stop Blaine and his planned mass suicide pact.
one_line: A South Park episode where the boys join David Blaine's cult, the Blaintologists, and Stan enlists Jesus and the Super Best Friends to stop it.
key_facts: "Super Best Friends" is the third episode of the fifth season of the American animated television series "South Park".
It is the 68th episode of "South Park" overall.
The episode first aired on Comedy Central in the United States on July 4, 2001.
In the episode, Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny discover the magician David Blaine performing in South Park.
The four boys decide to join Blaine's cult, the Blaintologists.
Stan quickly finds out that the Blaintologists are not as nice as everyone thinks.
Stan tries to convince the other boys that they have been brainwashed and have forsaken their friends and families.
Teaming up with Jesus, Stan calls upon the Super Best Friends.
The Super Best Friends are a parody of the Super Friends.
The Super Best Friends are called upon to destroy David Blaine.
The goal includes thwarting the mass suicide pact that Blaine has launched.
